NEW AMBIGUITY watchlisted: Skiddle places the Ex Cellar Jazz autumn residency at the KINGSTON branch while held rows say Surbiton - confirm before 18 Sep. Curation skips: Kris Barras at Fighting Cocks (blues-rock, fails the roots/trad-only rule), Once Upon a Time workshop (already held as ages-8-14 row), 26/27 Jul Fringe previews + Sofar/Andy Parsons/Never The Bride/Ex Cellar autumn/TDMR running days (all already held - dedupe prevented ~25 duplicates).
